drawing.svg: 29 shapes, 2801 bytes
pelican 7.0/10: The bird is clearly a pelican because of its long beak, big pouch, white body and grey wing, but the legs are thin orange sticks and the feet are tiny yellow wedges that barely read as webbed, and the body is a plain lumpy blob, so it is not the charming, fully drawn pelican an 8+ needs.
craft 7.0/10: It is a tidy, pleasant flat illustration, but a large empty band at the top unbalances the composition, the stick legs and blob body look awkward next to the cleaner bike, and the pelican looks a little small on the frame, so it is not yet poster-quality.
[cli:claude] Redraw the legs as thicker limbs with knees that bend the same way, ending in clearly webbed feet planted on the pedals. That would lift both the pelican and riding scores and remove the drawing's weakest-looking part.
